$description: Lolly starter tokens - ink-and-paper scaffolding, and nothing else. One neutral ramp (1 Ink through 9 Paper) carries surfaces, text and hairlines, and every semantic slot in both themes aliases into it, so a fresh install renders in black and white and the accent is ink until somebody picks a colour. A design system grows by ADDING colours in the #/start studio, not by clearing out a big preset palette. Layered DTCG: a shared 'base' set with the neutral ramp, the two faces (shell-served, no font binaries in this pack) and the default logo slots (asset.logo.*) pointing at the shipped Lolly marks, plus per-theme semantic slots that alias into the ramp. $values are hex; the engine's colorToHex reads either hex or oklch. Replace the lot via the #/start wizard or 'npm run ingest:brand'.

neutral.$description: Ink and paper - the whole starter palette, and deliberately colourless. Quiet true greys from 1 Ink (the darkest) to 9 Paper (the lightest), carrying surfaces, text, muted copy and hairlines; the themes invert the ramp so ink and paper swap. Nothing here is a brand colour: add your own in the #/start studio and the roles follow them.

brand.$description: UI & body - SUSE, the platform's default face. Shell-served from the web shell's public/fonts/ (not this catalog), so it resolves on every profile without the pack shipping font binaries. SIL OFL 1.1 - see this pack's README for the licence finding. Replace it by adding your own face in the #/start Type room.

mono.$description: Code, readouts & data - SUSE Mono, also shell-served and the platform's default mono on every profile. SIL OFL 1.1.

logo.$description: The blank starter's default logo marks - the Lolly swirl, shipped in this pack's catalog (lolly/logo/*). The mark is square, so horizontal and vertical share one file per treatment. Upload your own in the #/start Brand studio to override any slot.

muted-ink.$description: Captions, labels, axis years and descriptions: quieter than the text colour.

accent-ink.$description: Accent text: subtitles, emphasised runs and markers.

accent.$description: Accent marks: dots, ticks and check marks.

alert-ink.$description: Text that warns: a risk, a lock-in, the thing to avoid.

hairline.$description: Rules, axes and dividers on the slide ground.

card-hairline.$description: A rule drawn on a card.

track.$description: Bars and tracks of a timeline or chart.

card.$description: A neutral card or table cell.

strong-card.$description: An emphasised card: the column or cell the slide argues for.

quiet-alert-card.$description: A card that warns, quieter in the dark theme.
